finetune._comment: Modular head (MeSAE_modules FeatureHead): each features entry is {type, its own keys} and gets its own spatial filter. Types: stamp_power / stamp_band (log power, time_pool flat|learned|window|none, time_rank, window), signed_ab (signed phase-locked: stamp_rank, time_rank), evoked (evoked_rank), phase_advance, raw_band, raw_signal, latent_power / latent_signed (on the encoder output z; the default: latent_signed is the linear probe, z is the downstream representation, see docs/cards/2026-09-28-routed-stamps.md). Any entry may set its own spatial_k (default below).
